source: NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute, Cassini, 10 Sep 2007 (PIA08384), public domain; Wikimedia Commons: Iapetus_as_seen_by_the_Cassini_probe_-_20071008.jpg (3840 px)
steps: Least-squares circle on the sunlit limb (centre 1908.9, 1906.3; radius 1647.7 px); crop so the disc spans 970 of 1024 px like mimas.png; turn 113° so the photo's thin night edge falls on the shadow side (author's pick of three trials); clean circular alpha; multiply by content/icons/src/sphere template.png stretched over the disc, strength 1.4 (shading 40% deeper than the template).

provenance.description: Original mission photograph with scripted crop, alpha, rotation and/or lighting adjustments; no generative reconstruction.
